data.name: Ozius
data.long_meaning: The name Ozius is derived from the Latin word os, which means 'strength' or 'power'. In Christian tradition, Saint Ozius is revered as a bishop and martyr who suffered under the persecution of Emperor Diocletian. His strength and faith in the face of persecution inspires believers to this day.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and strength in the face of adversity.

in_hebrew.name: אוזיוס
in_hebrew.meaning: עוזיוס הינו שם נרדף לעוזיהו שמשמעותו עוזר האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עוזיוס הוא שם שמקורו בעברית ומשמעותו 'עוזר האל' או 'אל הוא עוזרי'. השם עוזיוס נגזר מהשם עוזיהו, שמורכב מהמילים 'עוז' שפירושה כוח או עוז, ו'יהו' שפירושה אלוהים. השם עוזיהו מופיע בתנ'ך כמלך יהודה (ספר מלכים ב', 15:1-7). השם עוזיוס משמש כנרדף לשם עוזיהו ומשדר אלוהי עוזר ותחזקות

in_greek.name: Ὀζίους
in_greek.meaning: Ὀζίους σημαίνει Θεός ἔστιν ἡ βοήθεια μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὀζίους ἦν ὄνομα παραγόμενο ἀπὸ τὸ Ὀζίας, ὃ σημαίνει 'Θεός ἔστιν ἡ βοήθεια μου' ἤ 'Θεός βοηθός'. Τὸ ὄνομα Ὀζίας προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἑβραϊκὴ λέξη 'עוזיהו', σύνθετη ἀπὸ 'עוז' (ἰσχύς) καὶ 'יהו' (Θεός). Ὀζίους εἶναι σύντομος μορφὴ τοῦ Ὀζίας, ποὺ εἶχε βασιλέψει ἐπὶ τῆς Ιουδαίας (Βασιλεῖς Β', 15:1-7). Ἡ σημασία τοῦ Ὀζίους ἐστὶ Θεὸς βοηθός

in_latin.name: Ozius
in_latin.meaning: Ozius significat Deus est adiutor meus
in_latin.long_meaning: Ozius nomen derivatum est a nomine Ozia, quod significat 'Deus est adiutor meus' vel 'Deus adiuvat'. Nomen Ozia provenit ex hebraico 'עוזיהו', compositum ex 'עוז' (fortitudo) et 'יהו' (Deus). Ozius est forma diminutiva Oziae, qui fuit rex Iudaeae (Reges II, 15:1-7). Ozius ergo est nomen theophoricum, quod exprimit adiutorium Dei

in_english.name: Ozius
in_english.meaning: Ozius means God is my helper or God helps
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Ozius is derived from the Hebrew name 'עוזיהו' (Oziah), which means 'God is my helper' or 'God helps'. Ozius is a variant of Oziah, a king of Judah mentioned in the Bible (2 Kings 15:1-7). The name is composed of 'oz' (עוז), meaning strength or help, and 'yah' (יהו), referring to God. In Christian tradition, Ozius symbolizes divine assistance and strength. The name has been adapted into various forms across cultures, reflecting its biblical roots and spiritual significance

data.cultural_impact: The name Ozius holds an illustrious history in the Christian faith as it was once borne by a holy bishop and martyr who endured religious persecution during the Roman Empire. The name speaks of courage, resilience, and loyalty to one's beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: Saint Ozius exemplifies unwavering faith and strength in the face of adversity. His name is a reminder of the power of faith and the ability to persevere through difficult times, even in the face of persecution. For those who bear the name Ozius, it serves as a constant inspiration to live a life grounded in faith and characterized by strength and resilience.

historical_references.reference: Ozius was a Roman bishop of the late 4th century, who was present at the First Council of Constantinople in 381. He opposed the election of Meletius as bishop of Lycopolis, and his faction continued to use Meletius' rival, Paulinianus, as bishop for several years after Meletius' election.
historical_references.context: Religious disputes and political maneuvering within the early Christian Church.

historical_references.reference: Ozius was a Gothic bishop who lived during the late 5th and early 6th centuries. He is known for trying to convert the Visigoths to Catholicism and for being a strong advocate for the use of Latin in the liturgy.
historical_references.context: Spread of Christianity among the barbarian tribes of Europe and the role of Latin in the liturgy.
